intro: A Wine Ticket is a promotional voucher distributed in Stormwind to drum up business for the Gallina Winery. Presenting it to Suzetta Gallina at the family shop earns the bearer a complimentary bottle of Pinot Noir.

p: Running a boutique vintage shop in a bustling metropolis like Stormwind requires savvy marketing. Renato Gallina hands out these printed tickets near the Trade District to draw thirsty patrons toward the Gallina Winery, which rests along the nearby canals. By promising a complimentary sample of their famous Pinot Noir, the Gallina family hopes to turn curious passersby and newly arrived adventurers into loyal lifelong customers.
